name: 市の手続きで使えるカードの扱いを追加
summary: 市税や印鑑登録に関する条例で、手続きに使うカードの扱いを定めています。この議案では、免許情報記録個人番号カードの扱いを整理し、印鑑登録証明書の交付申請などで特定在留カードなども提示書類に加えます。2026年6月14日から施行します。
changes: 免許情報記録個人番号カードに、法令上みなされた個人番号カードを含める
免許情報記録個人番号カードの場合の免許年月日を記載事項に加える
特定在留カードと特定特別永住者証明書を印鑑登録の手続きで使える書類に加える
who: 印鑑登録証明書の交付申請などをする人
免許情報記録個人番号カードを市税関係の手続きで使う人
why: 出入国管理及び難民認定法などの改正に伴い、印鑑登録証明書の交付申請などで提示する書類に特定在留カードなどを加えるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Adds rules for cards used in city procedures
en.official: Regarding the Enactment of an Ordinance to Organize Related Ordinances in Connection with the Enforcement of the Act Partially Amending the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act, etc.
en.summary: The city’s ordinances on city taxes and seal registration set out how cards used in procedures are handled. This bill clarifies how Driver’s License Information-Recorded Individual Number Cards are handled, and adds specified residence cards and other documents to the documents that may be presented when applying for the issuance of seal registration certificates and in other procedures. It takes effect on June 14, 2026.
changes: Include Individual Number Cards deemed under laws and regulations to be Driver’s License Information-Recorded Individual Number Cards, and add the license date for those cards to the information to be recorded
Add specified residence cards and specified special permanent resident certificates to the documents that can be used in seal registration procedures
who: People applying for the issuance of seal registration certificates and in other such procedures
People who use Driver’s License Information-Recorded Individual Number Cards in city tax-related procedures
en.why: The city says the change is being made in response to amendments to the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act and other laws, to add specified residence cards and other documents to those that may be presented when applying for the issuance of seal registration certificates, etc.
